facts.fact: 阿拉里克在私宴前回想，婚后与塔拉辛同桌的紧张饭局远多于愉快饭局
facts.anchor: It was a wretched state of affairs, Alaric reflected bitterly

facts.fact: 阿拉里克告知塔拉辛，马哈吉尔憩地已不再不可侵犯，父亲早在那儿设了基地
facts.anchor: “Mahagir’s Rest is no longer inviolate,” said Alaric. “My father already installed a base there.

facts.fact: 阿拉里克提醒塔拉辛，她加冕时当众宣誓服从他的意志，如今公开反对即是违约
facts.anchor: “Those same lackeys were present at the coronation when you swore your obedience to my will,” Alaric reminded her.

facts.fact: 阿拉里克要求塔拉辛把反对意见走正式程序提交，由他来研究裁定
facts.anchor: Make all the counterproposals and objections that you wish and I shall study them.

facts.fact: 塔拉辛解释婚戒放在首饰盒里，因为宝石松了才摘下
facts.anchor: “In my jewelry box. I took it off because the stone loosened.”

facts.fact: 阿拉里克把她的手按在胸口，要她答应再给他五十年
facts.anchor: “Because you will give me fifty more years, Talasyn.”

facts.fact: 塔拉辛一边恼恨自己屈从指令之快，一边折身伏在书桌上
facts.anchor: She sort of hated herself for how quickly she bent

facts.fact: 塔拉辛在他怀里放任自己想象那五十年，又怕自己贪求不可能之物
facts.anchor: Fifty more years of this. It was terrifying how much she wanted something she could never have.
